title: Best thing i did for myself as someone prototyping alot
author: Affectionate_Fact854
selftext:
The concept of web templates kept creeping up after I have made over 15 prototypes from blank and playable, especially now that i want to start a new concept.

  
So what I decided to do for 3 days was , take my experience , and shove it into a blank project 

 I created manually without ai a starter prototype template for my godot that includes 

All the general autoloaders, menus, overlays, scaffolded organized folders ,base title scene ,boot scene and fully connected browser sdk , index document, general usage Readme,  local save, cloud save, localization set up, settings audio,language select , free slot to add git https , and a clean project scope file 

This alone has freed up so much time, and now i just copy paste the template, give it to ai knowing it can  simply jump in and work on the game and i  don't have to repeatedly build the same base systems or stress its creating spagetti archetecture 

  
Such a good investment of time!
